scope: Resident Vietnam-established company, full calendar2026 and prior full calendar year; prior statutory revenue strictly over VND50bn, current revenue strictly over VND10bn. Ordinary20percent, no losses, exemptions, incentives or special tax claims. Ordinary business, interest, rental and royalty only.
basis: Saved receipts reconcile to complete current statutory revenue; group expenses equal saved deductions; every income appears exactly once. Eligible actual foreign tax cannot exceed saved payments.
All ten foreign catalog counterparts have treaty credit provisions. Decree320 Article12(2)(a) follows those treaties; non-treaty rules in12(2)(b) are not generalized to them.

Treaty direct credit is limited to Vietnamese20percent tax on the same net income. Singapore qualifying interest/royalty has the reviewed10percent-gross deemed floor; Indonesia qualifying interest/royalty uses15percent-gross deemed tax in place of, not added to, actual payments.
Current statutory revenue above VND10bn excludes Decree398 annual30percent relief; this scope avoids, and does not resolve, relief/credit ordering for lower revenue.
Foreign excess is displayed without automatically granting carryforward. Domestic prepaid tax offsets final liability separately. Results precede filing rounding, interest and penalties.
